title: Array Undertow
description: Scribed with Kelp and awakened by Redstone Dust. Opens a vitaemantic current through the open column of air directly above the glyph, lifting or drowning any entity that enters. Right-click with an empty hand to reverse the flow; the array remembers its direction across world reloads. Strength scales with additional Redstone in the redstone slot (acceleration) and Kelp in the kelp slot (terminal velocity); right-click the array with more ingredients to stack them.
